grid.layout_notes: Official game sheet: 5×3 base reel area expandable to 5×4 / 5×5 via Shadow Rows in main game and free spins.

win_system.notes: Official sheet: expanding rows adds win lines. Exact payline counts per row height are not printed on the public game sheet (marked unknown).

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: No cascade/tumble described on the official game sheet.

respins.how_it_works: Lucky Locks: after each main-game spin the player may choose which reels to lock and which to respin for an adjusted bet; Scatters can be held to improve Free Spin chance.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Shadow Rows: player pays additional cost to increase row count (and win lines) up to 5×5 in base and free spins.

base_game_loop.summary: Interactive 5-reel Book slot: choose row height (Shadow Rows), spin for left-to-right line wins, optionally Lucky-Lock/respin selected reels, optionally Gamble, or buy into Free Spins.

phases.name: Configure rows
phases.what_happens: Player may enable Shadow Rows (5×3 → 5×4 → 5×5) for an additional cost before/during play, increasing rows and win lines.
phases.state_changes: Active row height and payline set update.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop on the active grid. Matching symbols on active paylines from the leftmost reel score according to the paytable.

phases.name: Lucky Locks (optional)
phases.what_happens: After a main-game spin, player may lock selected reels (including Scatters) and respin the others for an adjusted bet.

phases.name: Gamble (optional)
phases.what_happens: Player may gamble a win 50/50 for double-or-nothing, or gamble the win into Free Spins.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: If 3+ Scatter/Wild Book symbols land (or Nolimit Bonus buy / successful gamble-to-bonus), enter Free Spins with Golden symbol.
phases.ends_when: No bonus or Free Spins completed

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Line wins evaluated on the active row configuration after each spin/respin; Golden expanding symbol evaluated during Free Spins when extra wins are possible.
base_game_loop.notes: Exact Shadow Rows cost multipliers and payline counts per height are not on the public sheet.

wilds.name: Scatter (Book) — also Wild
wilds.behavior: Official sheet: Scatters are also wild. Three or more grant Free Spins. Can be held via Lucky Locks.

scatters.name: Scatter (Book)
scatters.behavior: Three or more Scatters grant 10 Free Spins with a special Golden expand symbol.

specials.name: Golden expand symbol
specials.behavior: Awarded in Free Spins. Player may redraw the first Golden symbol draw. Golden symbols expand to cover the whole reel when additional wins can be awarded.

modes.name: Free Spins with Golden symbol
modes.trigger: Land 3 or more Scatters (which are also wild), or enter via Nolimit Bonus feature buy, or via Gamble-to-bonus.
modes.spins_awarded: 10 Free Spins (base). Choosing more/less Shadow Rows alters the number of spins given.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Golden expand symbol selected for the round (redraw of first draw allowed).
modes.end_condition: Free Spins counter reaches zero (exact retrigger rules not printed on public sheet).
modes.effects: Free Spins play with a special Golden expand symbol that can expand to a full reel for extra wins. Shadow Rows option changes both grid height and spins awarded.

phases.name: Select Golden symbol
phases.what_happens: Game awards a Golden expand symbol; player may redraw once if unhappy with the first draw.

phases.name: Choose Shadow Rows for FS
phases.what_happens: Player may pick more or fewer Shadow Rows, which alters the number of Free Spins given.

phases.name: Play Free Spins
phases.what_happens: Spins play on the chosen grid. When Golden symbols can create extra wins they expand to cover the whole reel.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Retrigger counts and exact spin totals per Shadow Row choice are not listed on the public game sheet.

features.name: Shadow Rows
features.effects: Increases number of rows and win lines (5×3 → 5×4 → 5×5) for more frequent wins and bigger payouts.
features.cost_text: Additional cost (multiplier not printed on public sheet)

features.name: Lucky Locks
features.effects: Choose which reels to lock and which to respin for an adjusted bet. Hold Scatters to increase Free Spin chance.

features.name: Gamble
features.effects: 50/50 double-or-nothing on winnings. Alternate path: gamble the winning straight into Free Spins.

features.name: Nolimit Bonus (Feature Buy)
features.when: Base game (may be removed in some regulated markets)
features.cost_text: Cost multiplier not printed on public sheet

options.name: Nolimit Bonus
options.cost_text: Not stated on public game sheet
options.effects: Buys directly into Free Spins. May be removed in some regulated markets.

feature_buy.notes: Official sheet confirms Feature Buy; exact price not on sheet.

ante_bet.effects: Shadow Rows is an optional extra-cost grid upgrade (ante-like), distinct from Nolimit Bonus buy.
ante_bet.notes: Exact cost multiplier unknown from public sheet.

numeric_limits.max_win_notes: Official sheet Max payout: 30,338 × bet (10 billion spin simulation).
numeric_limits.rtp_notes: Total RTP 96.01%; DX1 94.09%; DX3 90.15%. Main game RTP 58.70%; Bonus 37.31%.
numeric_limits.hit_frequency_notes: Hit frequency 33.18%. Bonus round 1 in 154 spins. Win ≥100× 1 in 843 spins. Volatility Extreme (10).

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A 5x3 reel area that can expand to 5x5 setup… Three or more Scatters (which are also wild) grants 10 Freespins with a special Golden expand symbol… Nolimit Bonus - allows the players to buy directly into the Freespin. Max payout: 30,338 x bet. Total RTP 96.01%.
Official game page lists RTP 96.01%, Max payout 30 338 x bet, Reels/Rows 3-5, Feature buy-in Yes, Bonus mode Yes.

unknowns: Exact Free Spins totals per Shadow Rows choice
